lines.en: I glide along the riverbed.
I turn fast in the water.
My tail drives me forward.
I swim just under the surface.
I skim the sandy bottom toward the bank.
I slip between the stones.

lines.zh: 我把鼻孔露出水面，吸气。
lines.en: I poke my nostrils above the surface and breathe.
I flick my tail into colder water.
I weave along the weeds.

lines.zh: 我从石头阴影里滑出来。
lines.en: I slide out of the shadow of the rocks.
I let my long snout skim the surface.
I ride the current.
I work along the bank.
I bank under the water.
I swim past with only faint ripples.
I slide over the sandy bottom.

lines.zh: 我朝你的方向绕了一圈。
lines.en: I swing a circle toward you.
I swim to the bank with only my eyes showing.
I hover, tail swaying gently.

lines.zh: 我悬在水草下，等岸上动静。
lines.en: I hover under the weeds, waiting for the bank to stir.
I hang midwater, quiet.
I wait for movement on the bank.
My snout is long and narrow.
I hang in the water and sway with the current.
I hold still among the weeds.
My scales are dark underwater.
I set my body in a line.

lines.zh: 我停在浅水，听岸上动静。
lines.en: I hover in the shallows, listening to the bank.
I float, nearly invisible.
My tail traces circles in the water.
I wait for the water to cool.
I keep my nostrils above the surface.
I raise my eyes from below the surface.

lines.zh: 我隔着水面盯住你的脚。
lines.en: I watch your feet through the water's surface.
I am measuring how far you are from water.
I do not come ashore; I wait for you to come down.
My long snout points at your shadow.
I rise a little.
I narrow my eyes.
You stand at the water's edge, hesitating.
I swim along the bank at your feet.
I don't even flick my tail.
I flick my tail and retreat.
I sink into the murk and stay there.
I sink and hide a while.
A new mark shows on my scales.
I make no sound at all.
I slowly right myself.
I retreat behind a stone.
I flick my tail and slip into a gap between the rocks.
I stare at you on the bank.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩尾巴，潜入暗处。
lines.en: I flick my tail and dive into the dark.
I glance and swim over.
I circle the thing fully.
I test it with a bite at the edge.
It sinks and I follow.
I cannot tell whether it is edible.
I push it above the surface.
I shake my head hard.
I drag it into the weeds.
I rise and sink again.
I lose interest in it.
You hit me and water splashes up.
You grab for me and catch only water.

lines.zh: 我从你的膝盖边擦过去。
lines.en: I brush past the side of your knee.

lines.zh: 我一摆尾，水花打在你脸上。
lines.en: One flick of my tail throws water in your face.
Our impact raises rings of water.
I retreat half a block and realign.

lines.zh: 你推我，只推起一圈水纹。
lines.en: You shove me and raise nothing but ripples.
The water churns cloudy.
You retreat onto the bank.
I dive from beside your feet.

lines.zh: 两条细长的影子在水中并排。
lines.en: Two slender shapes swim side by side.
Our snouts touch once.
We circle the weeds together.
It swims along my flank.
We rise to the surface together.
Our tails beat at once.
They cross paths on the bottom.
Neither of us makes a sound.
We dive together.

lines.zh: 它们的影子在水底重叠。
lines.en: Their shadows overlap on the bottom.
I clamp my jaws on it.
I push it onto the bank.
I drag it down.
It turns over in the water.
I bite it in two.
I look and let go.
I jam it into a stone crack.
I push it with my snout.

lines.zh: 我把那东西藏进水草里。
lines.en: I hide the thing in the waterweeds.
I hold it and circle once.
I stop in the water and turn to you.
I feel movement on the bank.
I swim toward the shallows.

lines.zh: 我把长吻对准你的脚踝。
lines.en: I point my long snout at your ankle.
This stretch of water is mine to patrol.
I fix on your feet.
I stop going in circles.
My tail is pulled tight.
You are very near the water.
I float a little higher.
I slip beneath your shadow.
You take a step; I swim a stretch.
I stay in the water the whole time.
You back off and I dive.

lines.zh: 我借水声掩住自己的动作。
lines.en: I let the sound of the water cover my movements.

lines.zh: 我一直藏在你的视线下面。
lines.en: I stay below the line of your sight.
I creep toward the shallows.
You are on a stone; I am below.
I count your steps from below.
I am one block from the bank.
I bite into your calf.
My long snout whips you.
I burst from the water into you.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的袖子往深处拽。
lines.en: I bite your sleeve and haul it deeper.
My teeth scrape your knee.
You are dragged into the shallows.

lines.zh: 我用长吻挑开你的护甲。
lines.en: I use my long snout to pry your armor open.
You grab the grass at the bank.
I let go and bite again.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的靴子往水下拽。
lines.en: I bite your boot and haul it under.
Ripples spread on the water.
I rise slowly off the muddy bottom.
The water by the bank suddenly deepens.
A long shadow appears here.
I swim in along the bottom.

lines.zh: 你看见水面下有个东西。
lines.en: You see something under the surface.
I begin patrolling this water.

lines.zh: 水面裂开一道细长的纹。
lines.en: A long, narrow wake splits the surface.
I poke my head from the weeds.
The water sounds stop for an instant.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴先在水下扫过。
lines.en: My tail sweeps under the water first.
I swim down from upstream.
The water shields me; only my back burns.

lines.zh: 我被抛到岸上，重重摔下。
lines.en: I am thrown onto the bank and land hard.

lines.zh: 我忽然喘不上气，只能往上游。
lines.en: I suddenly cannot breathe and must rise.
The blast bursts underwater and I roll.
An arrow pierces my flank.

lines.zh: 那股力量把我的动作定住。
lines.en: That force holds my motion still.
Hunger slows even my tail.

lines.zh: 电流顺着水爬满我的鳞。
lines.en: The current crawls over every scale.

lines.zh: 下面的水没了，我坠下去。
lines.en: The water below is gone; I drop.
